features: Position and lap hierarchy with a live four-row race classification
Single shared authored HUD prefab; race systems retain state authority
Race clock for races; lap clock and measured checkpoint split to valid session best for solo runs
Frame-rate instrument refresh, allocation-free clock formatting, twelve non-flashing RPM shift lamps and RCCP speed/gear
Temporary intro objective and lap-completion messages; persistent invalid-lap state without premature valid-lap claims
Compact device-aware pause prompt; keyboard and gamepad navigation preserved

validation.final720Rerun: Repeated after removing the redundant invalid-lap caption. No geometry changed after the 1080 layout pass.
validation.sourceDiffWhitespaceCheck: C# passed; Unity serialized YAML uses its normal blank-value spacing.

serializationNote: During original-project Play Mode Unity 6.3 serialized URP asset version 13, graphics keyword settings, material motion-vector settings and dynamic TMP font data. These were not reverted. No intentional rendering configuration change was made by this HUD feature.
limitations: Editor validation on macOS Metal; no new standalone build for this HUD change.
720p layout and virtual gamepad do not establish Nintendo Switch hardware performance.
Synthetic checkpoint and RPM boundary tests are labelled in their reports; they do not constitute a natural completed race.
Split comparison is sampled at actual race checkpoints, not a continuous distance-based delta.
firstAttemptRepairs: Authoring handles Unity fake-null CanvasGroup references explicitly.
Active-device polling moved before the telemetry throttle so one-frame gamepad presses are not missed.
Screenshot captures wait a frame before scene transitions.
